SMTO-PRX-0007 — SMTO doesn't know which Proxmox server to use

GUID: 90b47665-875c-4aa7-959b-3de578cd591b
Slug: proxmox-profile-missing
Domain: PRX · Subsystem: prx

What happened

  • Your request needs a Proxmox server, but no saved Proxmox Server details were attached to it and none was remembered from earlier in this conversation. Nothing was done on Proxmox.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. In your message, type @ and choose your Proxmox Server parameter from the list, then send the request again. SMTO only uses a Proxmox server you point to, so it never picks one on its own.
  2. If no Proxmox entry appears in the @ list, open Parameter Store, pick Proxmox Server in the template list next to the New button, select New, fill in server, username and password on the Value tab, and select Save. The @ list can only offer Proxmox servers that are saved in the Parameter Store.
  3. If you switched to a different Gateway or edited the Proxmox parameter during this conversation, mention the parameter with @ again. SMTO stops reusing a server it remembered earlier once the Gateway (the helper program SMTO uses to reach other computers) or the saved details change.

What success looks like

  • The Agent names your Proxmox server and returns the VM list or status you asked for.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't ask the Agent to use some other server instead; name the exact one you mean.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Proxmox profile selection found no accepted Proxmox @parameter binding, and no verified Working Context server on the current Gateway, matching the requested server_ref.

What this means

  • Profile selection finds zero accepted or currently verified candidate bindings matching server_ref and the selected Gateway. Proxmox task and resource receipts own effect truth. A failed read, expired local wait or invalid response does not undo a mutation; diagnostics never replay writes or escalate graceful shutdown to forced stop.

Why this can happen

  • Profile selection finds zero accepted or currently verified candidate bindings matching server_ref and the selected Gateway.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect accepted references and verified context; an unrelated stored profile is not automatically an eligible binding.

How to fix it

  • select_binding in agent_runtime/skills/proxmox/profile.py found zero candidates. Confirm the task's parameter_references include a server_connection record with service 'proxmox' whose normalized key matches server_ref, or that a verified Proxmox Working Context entry exists for the current Gateway with an unchanged profile revision. Attach the intended profile with @; do not substitute a different target into a saved run.
  • Select or create the exact intended Proxmox profile in Parameter Store.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • The task explicitly binds the intended current profile in its Gateway scope.

What not to do

  • Do not silently substitute a different target for a saved run or move its existing execution authority.

Technical notes

  • Proxmox task and resource receipts own effect truth. A failed read, expired local wait or invalid response does not undo a mutation; diagnostics never replay writes or escalate graceful shutdown to forced stop.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
